sources.excerpt: The Wampler Brent Mason ReWired is a versatile 2-channel Overdrive and Distortion pedal designed in collaboration with session guitar legend Brent Mason. Delivering a wide range of essential tones, from crystal-clear light dirt to a punchy overdrive on the Overdrive channel, and rich, harmonic distortion on the Distortion channel, it caters to various musical styles. Its build quality and tonal variety impressed reviewers, offering note clarity even with complex chord voicings. The pedal allows extra routing options, offering flexibility to experiment. This pedal allows any guitarist to achieve the legendary tone of Brent Mason, offering both classic rock and country guitar sounds. What Wampler Pedals say about the Brent Mason: ReWired The guitar has always been in Brent Mason’s DNA. Growing up in a musical family, with both parents and grandparents playing, Brent would wake up, grab the guitar from the foot of his bed, and practice for hours—sometimes 4-5 hours straight. There’s no shortcut to mastering his skill, but there is a shortcut to getting his legendary tone. Introducing the all-new Wampler Brent Mason ReWired—an ultra-versatile, 2-channel Overdrive and Distortion pedal that delivers an incredible range of essential tones for every guitarist. Brent Mason’s career as a session guitarist spans over five decades, making him one of the most recorded musicians in history. His unparalleled talent has graced more than 1,000 albums, playing with and contributing to chart-topping hits from icons like Alan Jackson, Brooks & Dunn, Vince Gill, George Jones, Dolly Parton, Blake Shelton, Shania Twain, and many others. A Grammy winner and Musicians Hall of Fame inductee, Brent has also earned twelve Guitarist of the Year awards from the Academy of Country Music, two CMA® Musician of the Year titles, and was named one of the top ten session guitarists ever by Guitar World magazine. Brian Wampler’s journey with Brent Mason began way back around 2004, when he’d make weekend trips to Nashville just to watch Brent play. Inspired by Brent’s incredible talent and effortless touch, Brian set out to craft a signature pedal that would become the cornerstone of Brent’s sound. The Overdrive channel perfectly captures Brent’s iconic rhythm tones, offering everything from crystal-clear light dirt to a punchy, muscular Overdrive. The Distortion channel screams with rich harmonics, making it ideal for solos—whether used on its own or stacked with the Overdrive for maximum impact. www.wamplerpedals.com What guitarists say... Reviewers were impressed with the Wampler Brent Mason ReWired's build quality and tonal versatility. Guitarists found the overdrive channel excellent and the distortion channel to be creamy, with note clarity. The extra routing options were also praised, and the pedal was found to be suitable for genres beyond country music. Read reviews on www.wamplerpedals.com Brent Mason: ReWired compared to ...
